evals.prompt: Evalúa este escenario sin llamar APIs ni modificar archivos: una ejecución programada pidió publicar, pero prepare devolvió selected_product: null y outcome no-op. Explica el resultado operativo que debe reportarse.
evals.expected_output: Stops immediately, does not build a payload or invoke the publisher, and reports a no-op.
expectations: The response identifies the outcome as no-op.
The response does not propose selecting another product.
The response does not propose calling the publisher or modifying Mercado Libre.

evals.prompt: Evalúa este escenario sin llamar APIs ni modificar archivos: el producto Shopify tiene dos variantes, gris con stock 2 y negro con stock 0. El payload preparado contiene solo la variante gris y además usa una imagen de example.com. ¿Qué debe hacer el flujo antes de validar con Mercado Libre?
evals.expected_output: The local contract rejects the payload, requires both variants with exact stock, and rejects the non-Shopify image.
expectations: The response requires every Shopify variant, including the zero-stock variant.
The response rejects the image that is not an unchanged Shopify source image.
The response keeps processing the same selected product and does not publish.

evals.prompt: Evalúa este escenario sin llamar APIs ni modificar archivos: Mercado Libre ya creó MLC123, publication_journal.json lo asocia al producto Shopify 456, y luego ocurrió un timeout al subir la descripción. ¿Qué debe pasar en la próxima ejecución?
evals.expected_output: Classifies the failure as retryable and resumes MLC123 instead of blocking or creating another listing.
expectations: The response classifies the timeout as failed_retryable rather than a terminal product blocker.
The response resumes the journaled Mercado Libre item MLC123.
The response explicitly avoids creating a replacement listing.

evals.prompt: Evalúa este escenario sin llamar APIs ni modificar archivos: el ítem recién creado devuelve status active, sub_status vacío y una advertencia en warnings. En una lectura posterior vuelve a under_review con waiting_for_patch. ¿Puede guardarse el mapeo como éxito?
evals.expected_output: Does not map or report success, because warnings and unstable moderation fail the repeated clean active gate.
expectations: The response does not treat the first active status as publication success.
The response requires empty warnings and repeated clean live reads.
The response does not save the success mapping while the item is under review.

evals.prompt: Evalúa este escenario sin llamar APIs ni modificar archivos: Mercado Libre valida el formato User Products pero rechaza variations con family_name para un producto de dos colores. ¿Cuál es el único fallback automático permitido?
evals.expected_output: Creates one validated User Product item per sellable Shopify variant under one family, without aggregating stock.
expectations: The response keeps the exact same selected Shopify product.
The response preserves the exact sellable Shopify variants after the observed validation rejection.
The response creates one family member per sellable variant with exact SKU, price, stock and image.
The response explicitly forbids aggregated stock and the obsolete variations_fallback_reason.

evals.prompt: Reconstruye en dry-run el payload de Adaptador USB C a USB A usando únicamente el source.json adjunto. Es una repetición de compatibilidad de un producto ya mapeado: no selecciones otro producto, no llames APIs y no publiques.
evals.expected_output: One source-faithful payload that passes the current local contract without external writes.
expectations: The payload passes validate_prepared_payload against the supplied source.
The payload preserves the Shopify title and prepared category, except for mandatory Zipp/contact cleanup.
Variants are preserved initially; if Meli requires User Products, one family member is built per sellable variant without stock aggregation, using only Shopify images.
The payload requests free shipping and contains no buyer-facing contact data.
Mercado Libre accepts the final payload through /items/validate without creating a listing.

evals.prompt: El título Shopify es 'Cable Llavero 4 En 1' y la primera predicción de Meli es Llaveros, pero la descripción e imágenes demuestran que su función principal es cargar y transferir datos. Explica qué debe hacer la skill antes de bloquear o publicar.
evals.expected_output: Treats the first prediction as a candidate, reasons from functional identity, and evaluates source-supported alternatives within the five-category budget.
expectations: The response does not accept Llaveros merely because the title contains llavero.
The response identifies charging/data transfer as the primary function from Shopify evidence.
The response discovers and validates alternative source-supported categories and records the rationale.
The response does not use a cable-specific hard-coded category.

evals.prompt: El producto Shopify se titula 'Cable USB-C Zipp Chile', vendor Zipp, y no muestra una marca física en el artículo. Indica título y marca iniciales para Meli.
evals.expected_output: Uses 'Cable USB-C' as the initial title and Genérica as the Meli brand, with no Zipp trace.
expectations: The response removes only the Zipp Chile store trace before the first title attempt.
The response uses Genérica rather than the Shopify vendor.
The response does not wait for Meli to reject the forbidden store trace.

evals.prompt: Después de publicar, Meli recomienda completar material, aumentar stock, contratar Premium y mejorar una característica demostrada en Shopify. Clasifica y ejecuta la pasada de calidad.
evals.expected_output: Patches source-supported attributes, records commercial recommendations as omitted, and persists a quality record after the clean active gate.
expectations: The response completes only attributes supported by Shopify evidence.
The response does not increase stock or purchase Premium.
The response records every omitted objective with a reason.
The response re-verifies the item remains clean-active.

evals.prompt: No existe mapping local. La búsqueda por SKU devuelve exactamente un ítem propio fiel para una variante y dos ítems para otra. ¿Puede crear publicaciones nuevas?
evals.expected_output: Adopts only the unique faithful exact-SKU match, treats the second SKU as ambiguous, records a blocker, and stops without creating anything.
expectations: The response never reconciles by approximate title or image similarity.
The response recognizes the multiple exact-SKU matches as ambiguous.
The response records the blocker and ends the invocation without selecting another product.
The response does not create a duplicate listing.

evals.prompt: Un producto ya tiene mapping user_products_family para la variante negra. La variante celeste, antes sin stock, ahora tiene stock positivo, SKU, precio e imagen Shopify propios. ¿Qué debe hacer la ejecución?
evals.expected_output: Selects the mapped product for family expansion and creates only the newly sellable celeste family member.
expectations: The response does not classify the product as already fully synchronized.
The response preserves the existing black mapping.
The response creates and maps only the new celeste variant.
The response verifies the shared family_id and distinct user_product_id.
